[![Watch the video](https://img.youtube.com/vi/H64AW1l-ae4/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H64AW1l-ae4)

## New
- **Excalidraw CLI for AI agents.** Local AI agents can create, edit, inspect, and export drawings, and run trusted scripts. Requires Obsidian 1.12.2+ with CLI enabled. Select **Excalidraw: Show CLI and agent instructions** to get started. [#2988](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2988)
- **Better image attachments.** Pasted and dropped images now follow Obsidian attachment rules, including compatible attachment-management plugins. [#2964](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2964)

## New from Excalidraw.com
- **Wrap or unwrap with W.** Put text inside a shape, detach labels, or wrap selected elements in a frame. Press W again to reverse the action. [#12264](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12264)
- **Select overlapping elements.** Alt-click to cycle through stacked objects. [#12237](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12237)
- **Smarter duplication.** Duplicated numbered labels and list items automatically advance their numbering. You can also Alt-drag to duplicate text while editing it. [#12189](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12189) [#12219](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12219)
- **Better cropping and resizing.** Shift maintains image crop proportions, Alt crops from the center, and double-clicking a crop handle restores an edge. Corner resizing for text is more intuitive. [#12260](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12260) [#12262](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12262)
- **Improved frames.** Edge-aligned elements are included correctly, clipping is more consistent, and cutting a frame includes its contents (deleting a frame still leaves them behind). [#12270](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12270)
- Google Drive videos start playing when you activate their embeds. [#12246](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12246)

## Fixed
- **Text undo/redo.** Editing after undo or redo no longer restores outdated text, and closing an unchanged editor preserves redo history. [#2976](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2976)
- **Markdown embeds.** Fixed blank or interrupted drawing embeds, nested and self-referencing drawing images, and back-of-the-note embeds showing the full drawing instead of the linked section. [#2953](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2953) [#2979](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2979) [#2931](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2931)
- **Grouped links.** Ctrl/Cmd-click selects the intended group member first; a second click follows that element's link. [#2989](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2989)
- **LaTeX in popouts.** Fixed cursor placement and keyboard selection when editing formulas in a separate window. [#2970](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/issues/2970)
- Middle-mouse panning over a text editor no longer ends text editing or multiplies the movement. [#12244](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/12244)

## Excalidraw Automate
- Scripts can use the new CLI through ea.executeCLI() and create drawings at an exact path with ea.create().

## What's Changed
* Save pasted and dropped images through internal `app.saveAttachment()` by @mnaoumov in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2964
* fix: back-of-the-note embeddable initializes as the full drawing when it mounts before the Canvas node factory is ready (#2931) by @askalf in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2959
* Support Obsidian CLI testing on Windows and macOS by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2983
* Document issue assessment and agent draft-PR handoff workflow by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2984
* Fix text reverting when editing after undo or redo (#2976) by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2987
* Fix grouped Ctrl/Cmd-click link navigation by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2989
* Fix interrupted and nested Markdown drawing embeds (#2953, #2979) by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2985
* Fix LaTeX editor input in popout windows (#2970) by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2991
* Add native Excalidraw CLI with backward-compatible Obsidian API gating by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2988
* fix: remove braces and patch source-map-js by @zsviczian in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2993

## New Contributors
* @askalf made their first contribution in https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/pull/2959

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin/compare/2.28.1...2.29.0
